en: Black‑and‑white image of an ornate vaulted interior hall with a highly decorated neo‑Gothic ribbed ceiling and patterned walls. The ribs are covered with floral ornament and converge in pointed arches. Oval portrait medallions of historical or religious figures run along the upper walls, framed by elaborate foliage. The lower walls are filled with repeated geometric and floral motifs, and there are pointed arched doors on both sides with intricate paneling. The floor is wooden parquet and the room is empty except for a single hanging light fitting in the center.
